E9SelfHealing.role: Robust quorum, syndrome visibility, response window and integer code headroom
E9SelfHealing.assessment: Robust means at least f+1 readings on each side. With at most f faulty identities, each side has an honest witness; existence needs K>=2f+1. Syndrome detection follows the supplied distance/centraliser property for errors outside the stabilizer with weight<d. The assembled theorem concludes alarm existence, honest alarm witness, timing inequality and correction-radius headroom.
obligations: Actual honest-sensor calibration, code-distance model, error accumulation and response service instantiate these inputs; the alarm theorem itself is not the whole physical trichotomy.

SpeedLimit.assessment: all statements reviewed with Solves, meanE and spreadE. A self-adjoint generator preserves the norm. branchA_divergence compares H0+V and H0 solutions using an operator-norm perturbation bound and normalised actual state. branchA_rate substitutes the explicit coupling bound. Mandelstam–Tamm is a time-independent self-adjoint Hamiltonian statement with energy spread and a normalised solution; the orthogonalisation inequality follows without adding a faster-than-causal signal premise.
obligations: Bind actual physical coupling, evolution and norm interpretation; do not turn a propagation upper limit into an achievable speed or a lower spreading rate.

BridgeE9.role: Timing algebra, buffering and divergence-free circulation counterexample
BridgeE9.assessment: The timing equivalence requires positive signal/harm speeds; positive margin further needs signal faster than harm. Buffer safety needs funded coverage of the full reaction interval. Applied>=commit>=detect establishes application after detection. The triangle incidence example has a nonzero circulation in the divergence kernel, so unchanged divergence is not preservation of the entire flow.
obligations: Actual distances, delays, signal paths, stored buffer and execution fencing.
TIWA conservation alone does not establish complete state preservation; this existing counterexample already illustrates the distinction.

BridgeD1.role: Survival/reward examples and exact preservation-cost criteria
BridgeD1.assessment: The explicit hazard 1+t grows without bound while its accumulated positive reward prefix persists. Discounted protective dominance has the exact cost criterion cost<reward*hazard/(discount+hazard). Undiscounted finite crossover needs positive net continuing reward and a sufficiently large horizon.
obligations: These results do not imply every terminal objective adopts preservation; the accepted H route remains essential.
This module does not remove the charged-event allowance in ReasonsCompiled; continue tracing the common-history comparison.

E9Routes.role: Finite disjoint-route survival and deadline composition
E9Routes.assessment: f+1 pairwise disjoint route vertex sets and at most f faulty vertices imply at least one clean route. The repair deadline theorem combines that witness with supplied clean-route detection, repair and service bounds.
obligations: Construct actual independent routes and their funded timing; numerical route count alone is not a physical network certificate.

SensorTail.role: MGF-based sensor tail with bounded adversarial bias
SensorTail.assessment: Chernoff bounds are stated for a probability measure, positive sigma, threshold beyond the bias, exponential integrability and the MGF bound. sensor_law_tail transfers an a.s.-strong pointwise adversarial bias cap into the tail statement.
obligations: Actual conditional sensor law and bias bound across admitted histories. The code does not infer subgaussianity from a sensor label.

ConsensusRate.assessment: Substitutes theta=R/(R+B) with nonnegative R, positive B and anchor weight 0<a<=1. Gives the exact contraction coefficient, unique scalar equilibrium and geometric error at every n.
obligations: Physical bandwidth, evidence law and private-evidence weighting are model bindings; a scalar contraction is not universal social consensus.

CorrelatedStress.assessment: many_touching extracts a shock subset from a cover of faulty locations. correlated_stress assumes local stochasticity on shocks and a per-shock cover cardinality bound k, and derives the combinatorial q^(|S|/k) bound. The result allows dependence through bounded shock footprints, not arbitrary unbounded common causes.
obligations: Actual shock law and footprint bound; this is a possible source for fault accounts rather than an empirical assertion that all real noise satisfies it.
CorrelatedStress.audit_note: Public helper many_touching is not individually printed in the 831-name audit. It is used by the audited correlated_stress theorem, so its dependencies are included transitively; add an explicit public-statement entry when reconciling the audit.

SafeGenesis.assessment: migration_progress integrates a supplied derivative progress bound. safe_genesis combines an existing barrier inequality with finite progress and nonnegative stock increments; it gives nonnegative h, progress by V0/c and nondecreasing resource stock.
obligations: Construct actual migration coordinates and establish those differential/resource inequalities. The conjunction alone does not construct an installed protector.
